title: Black Friday deal: Stock up on 20TB of cloud storage for $314.96
excerpt: Some things are worth buying in bulk, including cloud storage
content_html:
TL;DR: Scramble Cloud’s 20TB lifetime subscription is down to $314.96 (reg. $1,440) this Black Friday with code CLOUD, offering encrypted cloud storage without recurring fees.

Credit: Scramble Cloud

$314.96
$1,440 Save $1,125.04

Nobody needs 87 nearly identical photos of their dog, but who has the heart to delete them? If you’re the sentimental type when it comes to your digital files, Scramble Cloud is offering 20TB of lifetime cloud storage for $314.96 (reg. $1,440) this Black Friday with the code CLOUD.

That’s plenty of room for years of family photos, vacation videos, work documents, and those random files you’re convinced will come in handy someday. And with that much personal data sitting in one place, privacy is worth considering.

Developed in Germany, Scramble Cloud uses end-to-end encryption to protect files before they even leave your device, along with a zero-knowledge architecture designed to prevent the provider from accessing your stored content. Two-factor authentication adds another layer of account protection.

Scramble Cloud isn’t just a digital dumping ground, either. You can organize documents using a familiar folder structure, preview compatible files in your browser, and stream MP4 videos directly from your account. And if you’d like to subject your family to all those vacation photos, private sharing links, encrypted groups, and customizable file permissions let you decide who gets access to what.

Apple iPad Mini A20 Pro Chip 128GB Tablet (2026 Release, Midnight) — $599.00 (List Price $699.00)

If you’d rather manage files through your computer’s native file explorer than open another browser tab, Scramble supports WebDAV integration. More technically inclined users can also access their storage through a command-line interface.

Before you attempt to upload your entire digital existence in one sitting, there are two restrictions worth knowing about: Individual files cannot exceed 5GB, and uploads are capped at 70GB per day. If you’re transferring an extensive digital archive, you’ll need to spread the process across multiple days.

The offer is available to new and existing users, although redeeming a new code will replace an existing Scramble Cloud plan rather than add to its capacity. You’ll need to redeem your code within 30 days of purchase.
